page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred title lines at top, with a woodcut engraving in the middle, below it the imprint and date. Handwriting in the upper right margin and show-through from the reverse are not printed text and are left out.
page.notes: The date is printed in the old reversed-C form "cIↄ Iↄc LXXXII", converted to MDCLXXXII (1682). The banner in the engraving reads "CONSULTORIBUS"; its first letters are clear but the end of the banner is partly hidden, so the rest is not transcribed. The handwritten "2" in the top right corner, the handwritten "Leydeckeri" note in the right margin, the small handwritten mark under the date, and the show-through text in the background are not printed and are left out.
